name: ArtifactExtendedContactDetail
title: Artifact Extended Contact Detail
description: Contact details (including purpose and address) to assist a user in finding and communicating with the publisher.
purpose: This extension is defined to support representing artifact metadata on resources that do not already have an element using the ExtendedContactDetail type, and that behave in a definitional way. For example, it would not be appropriate to use this extension on a patient-specific resource such as MedicationRequest or CarePlan.

element.definition: Contact details to assist a user in finding and communicating with the publisher.
element.comment: May be a web site, an email address, a physical address, a telephone number, etc.
